notes: Renamed from placeholder fi-ansp. The official page https://www.fintraffic.fi/en/ans is titled 'Fintraffic Air Navigation Services Ltd' and its menu covers Air Navigation Services (ATC services, AIS, flight procedure design). The Fintraffic logo on fintraffic.fi exists only as a symbol inside the sprite sheet /themes/custom/traffic/dist/sprites/graphics.svg (referenced as graphics.svg#logo), not as a standalone logo file, and storing the whole sprite would not be a logo asset; no standalone file was located. The site's media page (/en/media), other brand-style paths and the site stylesheets returned HTTP 406 to this tool's requests.
